sessions.phase_label: Hero design selection and visual refinement
Webflow development, content revisions, lead capture, and launch

requirements.title: Concise Public Landing Page
requirements.definition: The main public marketing experience is a concise SaaS landing page rather than a large multi-page marketing website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the main-page architecture only; hero content, calls to action, lead capture, privacy access, and domain behavior are independently evolving Requirements.

requirements.title: Mobile-Responsive Layout
requirements.definition: The landing site must adapt cleanly for mobile displays.
requirements.boundary_note: This independently testable layout constraint is explicit in the opening specification; messages about depicting a phone in the hero concern imagery rather than responsive behavior.

requirements.title: Clean Minimal SaaS Visual Design
requirements.definition: The site must use a clean, minimal SaaS design aligned with the supplied brand colours, logo, references, and approved layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the overall visual system and layout direction; motion, hero copy, hero imagery, and individual page assets can change independently.

requirements.title: Animation-Free Presentation
requirements.definition: The current landing site must not use animations.
requirements.boundary_note: Animation behavior can be enabled or changed without changing the site's clean SaaS visual style, so it remains a separate constraint.

requirements.title: Hero Headline and Explanatory Copy
requirements.definition: The hero must display the client-confirmed headline and supporting product explanation.
requirements.boundary_note: Headline and body text form one hero-message mechanism; the accompanying product visualization is independently replaceable.

requirements.title: Hero Product Visualization
requirements.definition: The hero must visually demonstrate the LOTCLIP sales-page product, including a recognizable mobile-phone presentation and relevant product content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the hero's product-demonstration media and composition; hero wording and the separate bottom-page image have independent lifecycles.

requirements.title: Bottom-of-Page Image
requirements.definition: The lower portion of the landing page must use the client-selected replacement image.
requirements.boundary_note: This asset is independently replaceable and is not part of the hero visualization.

requirements.title: Dealer Login Call to Action
requirements.definition: A dealer-login button must appear only in the site's top-right area and navigate to the supplied login URL.
requirements.boundary_note: Placement and destination are attributes of one login-navigation mechanism; the early-access call to action has a different destination and lifecycle.

requirements.title: Request Early Access Navigation
requirements.definition: Selecting Request Early Access must open the contact page containing the early-access form.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers CTA navigation only; page messaging, form fields, and submission delivery can each change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Form-Only Contact Channel
requirements.definition: The contact page must present the form as the sole contact method and omit standalone email and phone contact options.
requirements.boundary_note: Removing displayed email and phone contact options does not prohibit collecting a phone number inside the form.

requirements.title: Founding Dealer Contact-Page Copy
requirements.definition: The early-access contact page must display the approved Founding Dealer headline and explanatory campaign copy accurately.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers rendered page messaging and copy accuracy; form schema and submission processing are independently testable.

requirements.title: Early Access Form Fields
requirements.definition: The early-access form must collect first name, last name, phone, email, dealership, city, and a comment.
requirements.boundary_note: The listed fields are parameters of one form-schema mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Contact Form Email Delivery
requirements.definition: Each form submission must be delivered to both client-specified email recipients.
requirements.boundary_note: Submission transport and recipient routing form one independently verifiable mechanism; form fields and page copy remain separate.

requirements.title: Privacy Policy Access
requirements.definition: The public site must provide an accessible Privacy Policy page or section.
requirements.boundary_note: This legal-content access requirement is explicit in the opening specification but is not revisited in the supplied messages.

requirements.title: Webflow Platform and Basic Hosting Plan
requirements.definition: The landing site must be built and hosted through Webflow using the cheapest suitable basic site plan.
requirements.boundary_note: Webflow and the selected site-plan tier are coupled platform-configuration parameters; DNS destinations are separate routing Requirements.

requirements.title: Landing Site Subdomain Routing
requirements.definition: The Webflow sales website must be served from the client-selected subdomain rather than replacing the existing product at the root domain.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the landing site's own DNS destination; preservation of the root product and its www alias have separate observable outcomes.

requirements.title: Existing Product Root-Domain Routing
requirements.definition: The existing LOTCLIP product must remain available at its established root-domain destination and must not be displaced by the Webflow landing site.
requirements.boundary_note: The root destination was restored independently while the www hostname remained broken, demonstrating a separate failure and recovery trajectory.

requirements.title: Existing Product WWW-Domain Routing
requirements.definition: The product's www hostname must resolve through Firebase and redirect or route to the established product site rather than display Site Not Found.
requirements.boundary_note: This hostname remained faulty after root-domain restoration, giving it an independent runtime and remediation trajectory.
